# Core Requirements

- The end goal is stability, speed and great user and developer experience.

## Code quality Requirements
- Update the `README.md` file to provide clear instructions on how to set up and run the project
- Follow standard Typescript conventions and best practices
- Use the composition API when creating Vue components
- Use clear, descriptive names for variables, functions, and components
- Accessibility should always be a first-class consideration
- Add comments only to explain complex logic or non-obvious implementations
